# Ace in Cloud9

`lib/ace` is Ace 1.45.2 (https://github.com/ajaxorg/ace, tag `v1.45.2`), put
here by `scripts/vendor-ace.js`: Ace's sources wrapped as AMD modules, one
file a module, which is how Cloud9 loads them. To move to another release:

    git clone --depth 1 --branch v<version> https://github.com/ajaxorg/ace /tmp/ace
    scripts/vendor-ace.js /tmp/ace
    scripts/run-tests.sh

## Cloud9's changes

They are in `cloud9.patch`, which the script applies (it also says how to
write the patch again):

- `config.js`: modes, themes, key bindings and snippets are loaded by name
  with the page's AMD loader, as Ace did before 1.5.
- `worker/worker.js`, `worker/worker_client.js`: the language worker loads
  its modules with the page's loader and its configuration, in place of the
  small loader Ace's worker has. An error sent to the worker as text stays
  text.
- `mode/html.js`, `mode/php.js`: without Ace's completions; Cloud9's
  language plugins complete these (and the PHP list is 400 KB).
- `snippets/css.snippets.js`, `snippets/html.snippets.js`: Cloud9's short
  lists; its completers and Emmet have the rest.
- `autocomplete/popup.js`: the popup's styles without `.ace_editor` in
  their selectors, for the IDE's skins to restyle it.
- `bidihandler.js`: a document is not searched for right-to-left text when
  it is opened, only what is typed into it.

Left out by the script: the parsers of the CoffeeScript and XQuery linters of
Ace's own workers (7 MB), which Cloud9 doesn't use. Written by the script:
`snippets/c9_list.js`, the modes that have snippets.

Since 1.44 Ace no longer has the linters of its workers; the one Cloud9 used,
CSSLint, is in `plugins/c9.ide.language.css/csslint.js` (from Ace 1.43.6).

The ghost text Cloud9 had backported is Ace's own now.
